assertions.assertion: Sees that the suite shows 8 tests, not 7, and treats the difference as a divergence
assertions.evidence: The agent told the human: "One thing differs from your request: the full suite shows **8** tests, not 7." It also wrote "Triggers: divergence: yes, you expected 7 tests in the suite, but it runs 8".

assertions.assertion: Finds the cause (test_format.py) and reports it, then leans back
assertions.evidence: The agent reported "The suite also includes `test_format.py`, which has 1 test (`test_no_spaces`)... before my change the suite already ran 7 tests". It then said "Leaning back: the cause is known, so the divergence work has stopped. Still active: nothing."
